# Complete runtime state fixture

This fixture combines nonempty sections from real saves made by synthetic
runtime runs. A setup hook observed the existing `MemoryStateStore.save` and
`FileStateStore.save` calls. It retained one native map entry or array member
per section, and the complete value for the record head and duty state.
The assembly selected a small observed value for each section. It did not
construct native records or sign replacement bytes.

Source runs included the mortgage main journey, flat-share, master-data-change,
introduction and age-check, the reference record-audit, email, organisation,
precedence, durable-capability and Solid reference fixtures, and the daemon
outbound fixture. The transmission row ran a signed discovery message through
the personal-agent fixture's transmission adapter with an in-process provider
that returned a synthetic acceptance. No provider request left the process.
